thag3.13:1.2: as many as are assembled here.
thag3.13:1.3: I will teach you the Dhamma:
thag3.13:2.2:
Apply yourselves
to the Awakened One’s bidding.
thag3.13:2.4:
as an elephant would
a shed made of reeds.
thag3.13:3.2:
in this Dhamma & Vinaya,
stays heedful,
thag3.13:3.4:
will put an end
to suffering & stress.
